name: LoVoCCS-2
morph_notes: SB discontinuity obvious to the bottom left (south-east) cluster

name: LoVoCCS-4A
morph_notes: Two outer islands, one to the south (with irregular structure) and one to the west-south-west of the main cluster

name: LoVoCCS-5
morph_notes: A3667, famously complicated morphology.

name: LoVoCCS-7
morph_notes: Would have been 'R', but for the apparent sharp-ish drop in surface brightness around much of the left (east) side - it is possible this is an instrumental effect.

name: LoVoCCS-9
morph_notes: Similarities to LoVoCCS-5; large and puffy but with clear structure in the middle; OI directly to the right (west) of central coordinate, part of but slightly extending from main emission

name: LoVoCCS-11
morph_notes: 'Tail' is below (south) the body of the emission, quite unusual structure but instrumental effects could be contributing; Overall quite similar in classification to LoVoCCS-5.

name: LoVoCCS-12
morph_notes: Slight sharp drop near core

name: LoVoCCS-13
morph_notes: Outer island to the south of the centre of the ICM; Tail less certain but to the south-west, may be a misinterpretation of another emission blob that doesn't quite qualify as an outer island.

name: LoVoCCS-14
morph_notes: Nearly classified as LFB, but there it isn't entirely flat in brightness; sharp drop to the left (east) of main centre, possibly partially an instrumental effect

name: LoVoCCS-15
morph_notes: A2597 - hugely powerful cool-core cluster. Small extended emission to the north-north-east (upper left) of the cluster is a higher redshift (z~0.5) cluster.

name: LoVoCCS-18
morph_notes: Strong central core emission, but not as extremely peaked as clusters we are labelling CeP; sharp drop to the left (east) of centre.

name: LoVoCCS-21
morph_notes: Similar to LoVoCCS-5 and LoVoCCS-9; sharp drop to the south-east (lower left) of centre; potential  tail extending upper right but not sure so didn't add modifier

name: LoVoCCS-22
morph_notes: Very VERY bright point source to the left (east) of centre - identified as a (likely) background AGN.

name: LoVoCCS-24
morph_notes: Very distinct tail feature that appears to be slightly curved, hence the Sp modifier.

name: LoVoCCS-27
morph_notes: Very distinct sharp drop off to the left (east) of centre.

name: LoVoCCS-28
morph_notes: Apparent faint tail to the east north east (top right) of centre, though could be instrumental effect.

name: LoVoCCS-30
morph_notes: Distinct sharp drop off associated with possible outer island to the north of centre, with sharp edge evident to the north-north east (just left and up) of centre.

name: LoVoCCS-35
morph_notes: Small extended source well outside extended emission to the south-south-west (lower right) near the edge of the FoV is a background cluster.

name: LoVoCCS-39
morph_notes: THIS CLASS IS LIKELY WRONG AS THE CENTRAL EMISSION ORIGINATES FROM A POINT SOURCE; Extended source to the north-north-west (up and slightly right; [229.6332015, 6.4015550]), appears to be another cluster at similar redshift

name: LoVoCCS-41A
morph_notes: Outskirts intersect with LoVoCCS-41B, but not quite enough for a MM classification.

name: LoVoCCS-41B
morph_notes: Outskirts intersect with LoVoCCS-41A, but not quite enough for a MM classification. There is a small blob to the south-south-west (lower right) of the centre, which is a background cluster at z~0.56.

name: LoVoCCS-42
morph_notes: Sharp-ish SB drop to the south-west (bottom right) of centre; possible tail to the east (left) but not certain enough to add modifier

name: LoVoCCS-45
morph_notes: Southern (lower) edge of ICM seems to have a sharp SB drop

name: LoVoCCS-46A
morph_notes: Multi-modal broad morphology classification shared with LoVoCCS-46C, the other contributor to the bimodal appearance. Unassociated extended source to the west (right) side of the FoV is another cluster at z~0.3.

name: LoVoCCS-46B
morph_notes: Distinctly different morphology from the other two components of LoVoCCS-46

name: LoVoCCS-46C
morph_notes: Multi-modal broad morphology classification shared with LoVoCCS-46A, the other contributor to the bimodal appearance

name: LoVoCCS-48A
morph_notes: Shares MM classification with LoVoCCS-48B, which is the other contributor to the bimodal appearance. Has complex centre, very bright peaked core-like region and slightly extended bright region. Sharp drop to the west (right) of centre - possibly exacerbated by instrumental effect from coadding.

name: LoVoCCS-48B
morph_notes: Shares MM classification with LoVoCCS-48A, which is the other contributor to the bimodal appearance. Very bright peaked core-like region.

name: LoVoCCS-49
morph_notes: Definite point + possible extended emission from foreground (z~0.07) elliptical/group to the south-west (lower right; [175.2477, -12.3985]).

name: LoVoCCS-58
morph_notes: Directly south (down) of centre there is a very bright point source we have identified as the star 'AS Cap'; faint slightly extended source to the north-east (left and slightly up) of centre ([323.6770, -13.3910]) MAY be a background group, but redshift is not clear.

name: LoVoCCS-60A
morph_notes: Nearly a MM with LoVoCCS-60B, but the two distributions are distinguishable.

name: LoVoCCS-60B
morph_notes: Nearly a MM with LoVoCCS-60A, but the two distributions are distinguishable. Apparent hard drop in SB along the western (right) edge of the ICM

name: LoVoCCS-61
morph_notes: Unusual appearance; slightly narrowing tail to the north, with a curved edge (hence the Sp modifier); that curved edge is quite a sharp discontinuity in SB.

name: LoVoCCS-65
morph_notes: Very low-z puffed up cloud; there appears to be a sharp drop in SB to the south.

name: LoVoCCS-66A
morph_notes: Multi-modal with LoVoCCS-66B; has a relatively bright and large central region (somewhat similar to 'Regular' or 'Structured' classes (hence +Pl); seemingly quite a sharp drop in SB past that plateua; tail-like structure connecting to LoVoCCS-66B.

name: LoVoCCS-66B
morph_notes: Multi-modal with LoVoCCS-66B; small bright core region; seeming sharp drop in SB around the lower edge

name: LoVoCCS-67
morph_notes: Has a z~0.94 background cluster at [359.0689 -34.6941]; an X-ray bright spiral at [] and z=0.0422 apparent as a small blob in the ICM emission; VERY powerful core; sharp edges in SB especially to the north and east (left); possible void but can't be sure with this data.

name: LoVoCCS-75
morph_notes: Bright core is slightly elongated

name: LoVoCCS-90
morph_notes: Nearby-ish cluster at [227.6508, 6.2661], z~0.175

name: LoVoCCS-93A
morph_notes: Very close to LoVoCCS-93B; tail-like emission to the east (right) of centre apparently connecting to the elongated emission of LoVoCCS-93B

name: LoVoCCS-93B
morph_notes: Very close to LoVoCCS-93A; nearly classed as LFB, but has a bright ish core, and elongation looks like a not quite finished merger

name: LoVoCCS-98
morph_notes: Complex...; sharp edge to the south-west (lower right); bright core like to the west of centre; that along with previously mentioned sharp edge form a spiral-like, tail-like, structure; associated faint X-ray feature at [358.5828, -10.3252], in optical there is diffuse blue (at least in LS imagery) emission, and in UV there is extended emission (this collection of galaxies has MUSE data)

name: LoVoCCS-119
morph_notes: Really strong core

name: LoVoCCS-121
morph_notes: Fairly straightforward multi-modal morphology, but physically complicated. North-eastern (up and right) extended source that makes up the other component of the multi-modal distribution is likely a cluster at a much higher redshift (z~0.44). Seems to have a little substructure (hence OI) almost directly east (left) of LoVoCCS-121 central coordinate (at [52.7990339 -52.6002847]; z~0.056)

name: LoVoCCS-134
morph_notes: Close [329.5401, -60.2453] faint extended source (hence OI); it is associated with the cluster (coincides with one of the BCG candidates manually selected for this system (BCG3, though that may change).
